title: Omm Vedic Numerology Promotional & Booking Website

requirements.text: Create a visually rich homepage for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' that prominently displays the brand name and showcases the four core services: Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, and Pronology. Each service should have a dedicated section with a title, brief description, and a call-to-action button linking to the booking form. The page must include a hero section with a spiritual/mystical theme and a navigation bar.

quotes: promotes my service like tarot card reading, numerology, vastu and pronology with the name of omm vedic numerologgy or omm vedic numerology

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders the brand name 'Omm Vedic Numerology' in the header and hero section
All four services (Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology) are displayed as individual cards or sections
Each service card shows a title, description, price (₹400), and a 'Book Now' button
Navigation bar links to the Services section and Booking section
Hero section has a spiritual/mystical visual theme

requirements.text: Implement a backend data model for service bookings. Each booking must store: service type (Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology), booking category (Appointment, Home Tour, Name Change), customer name, phone number, preferred date, optional message, and a status field (pending/confirmed). Expose backend functions to create a booking and retrieve all bookings.

quotes: it can used by many people who want to have appointment,or do a home tour or , name change

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores bookings with all required fields
createBooking function accepts all required fields and returns the new booking ID
getBookings function returns all stored bookings
Booking category supports 'Appointment', 'Home Tour', and 'Name Change' as valid values

requirements.text: Build a booking form page/section on the frontend that allows users to submit a request for any of the three categories: Appointment, Home Tour, or Name Change. The form must include fields for: service type selection, booking category selection, full name, phone number, preferred date, and an optional message. Display the price as ₹400 prominently. On successful submission, show a confirmation message.

quotes: it can used by many people who want to have appointment,or do a home tour or , name change make the price of 400rs

acceptanceCriteria: Form includes dropdowns for service type and booking category
Form includes inputs for full name, phone number, preferred date, and optional message
Price of ₹400 is shown clearly on or near the form
On submission, the booking is saved to the backend
A success confirmation message is shown after a successful booking
Form validation prevents submission with missing required fields

requirements.text: Add a Services & Pricing section on the homepage that lists all four services with clear descriptions and a unified price of ₹400 per session. Include a brief explanation of each: Tarot Card Reading (intuitive card-based guidance), Numerology (life path and number analysis), Vastu (space energy and home alignment), and Pronology (name and sound vibration analysis).

quotes: tarot card reading, numerology, vastu and pronology

acceptanceCriteria: All four services are listed with names and short descriptions
Each service shows the price ₹400
Section is visually distinct and easy to read
Each service card links to or scrolls to the booking form

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive mystical/spiritual visual theme across the entire website. Use a deep cosmic color palette (dark navy, gold, and warm amber tones), elegant serif or display typography for headings, and subtle celestial or mandala-inspired decorative elements. The layout should feel premium and trustworthy, consistent across all sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette uses deep dark backgrounds with gold/amber accent tones
Headings use an elegant, distinctive font
Decorative elements (stars, mandalas, or celestial motifs) are used tastefully
Theme is applied consistently to the hero, services, and booking sections
Overall aesthetic feels premium and spiritual

requirements.text: Generate and display a banner/hero background image and service icon illustrations for each of the four services, rendered as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays the generated background image
Each of the four service cards displays its respective icon illustration
Images load correctly from frontend/public/assets/generated

constraints: All services must be priced at exactly ₹400
The brand name must be displayed as 'Omm Vedic Numerology'
Do not use blue or purple as primary colors
nonGoals: Online payment processing or payment gateway integration
Email or SMS notifications for bookings
